# Reyansh Vedanta

> Premium 1 & 2 BHK residential project by Reyansh Group at Daulat Nagar, Borivali East, Mumbai

## Project Overview

Reyansh Vedanta is a MahaRERA-registered (PR1180002602217) residential tower offering thoughtfully designed 1 BHK and 2 BHK lifestyle homes in Daulat Nagar, Borivali East, Mumbai – 400 066. Developed by Reyansh Group, the project stands at the junction of Road No. 4 & 10.

## Location Details

- **Address**: Junction of Road No. 4 & 10, Daulat Nagar, Borivali East, Mumbai – 400 066
- **Locality**: Daulat Nagar, Borivali East
- **City**: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- **PIN Code**: 400 066
- **Coordinates**: 19.2307° N, 72.8567° E

## Configurations Available

- 1 BHK Lifestyle Residences
- 2 BHK Lifestyle Residences

- Borivali Railway Station (East): 5-minute walk

- Dahisar Railway Station (East): 1.1 km
